mapper.sql:
WITH metrics AS (
SELECT v.voter_user_id AS user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT v.proposal_id) AS metric_value FROM decision_votes v JOIN purchase_proposals p ON p.id=v.proposal_id WHERE v.cast_at >= #{start} AND v.cast_at < #{end} AND p.proposal_status NOT IN ('DRAFT','WITHDRAWN') AND v.voter_user_id <> p.creator_user_id GROUP BY v.voter_user_id
SELECT p.creator_user_id AS user_id,SUM(e.converted_amount) AS metric_value FROM purchase_proposals p JOIN exchange_rate_snapshots e ON e.proposal_id=p.id AND e.target_currency='HKD' WHERE p.proposal_status='SETTLED' AND p.participation_type='APPROVE_REJECT' AND p.decision_result=1 AND p.settled_at >= #{start} AND p.settled_at < #{end} GROUP BY p.creator_user_id
SELECT p.creator_user_id AS user_id,COUNT(*) AS metric_value FROM purchase_proposals p WHERE p.proposal_status='SETTLED' AND p.participation_type='APPROVE_REJECT' AND p.decision_result=0 AND p.settled_at >= #{start} AND p.settled_at < #{end} GROUP BY p.creator_user_id
), ranked AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY m.metric_value DESC,m.user_id ASC) AS rank_no, m.user_id,u.public_no,u.display_name,u.avatar_url,m.metric_value FROM metrics m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE u.account_status='ACTIVE' )
rank_no,CAST(user_id AS CHAR) AS user_id,CAST(public_no AS CHAR) AS public_no,display_name,avatar_url,metric_value
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ranked ORDER BY rank_no LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
